svg.text: WF-006 — Defensive 4 KiB split and response aggregation

Stimulus crosses the AHB 1 KiB rule and is out of profile; it checks defensive AXI 4 KiB splitting only. Either sub-burst error makes final AHB HRESP=ERROR. / Kích thích vượt quy tắc AHB 1 KiB nên ngoài profile; chỉ kiểm tra split AXI 4 KiB. Lỗi ở sub-burst nào cũng làm HRESP cuối báo ERROR.
